question: When was the Asian Games organised in India for the second time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1982**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Asian Games **were organized in India for the second time in the year **1982**.
 
• India hosted the Asian Games for the first time in **1951** and then again in **1982** in New Delhi.
 
• The 1982 Asian Games, also known as the **IX Asiad**, witnessed participation from 33 countries with over 4,500 athletes competing in 21 sports.
 
• The games were held from **November 19 to December 4, 1982**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Asian Games is a continental multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• The** first Asian Games were held in New Delhi, India, in 1951**.
 
• The Asian Games are recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) and are described as the second largest multi-sport event after the Olympic Games.
 
• In 1982, India showcased significant improvements in infrastructure, including the construction of the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, which became the main venue for the games.
 
• The **mascot **for the 1982 Asian Games was "Appu," an **elephant**, symbolizing the host country, India.
